description: Positive whole-function include masks selecting the C++ implementation sections modeled by lean/consistency inside multi-purpose RPC and endpoint files (include/ccf/tx_status.h is included whole without a mask). Selects transaction status evaluation (/tx and get_status_for_txid_v1), initial x-ms-ccf-transaction-id header emission and default forwarding policies (endpoint_registry.cpp), and the RpcFrontend execution, forwarding, session-consistency, and commit/retry loop (frontend.h, including exception handlers).

Populates x-ms-ccf-transaction-id on initial responses and sets default ForwardingRequired policies for write, read-only, and command endpoints
Executes endpoint handlers and locally committed TxID response callbacks
Binds consensus instance used by status evaluation
Pins session active view and aborts requests on view change to preserve session consistency

Commits transactions, invokes locally_committed_func to emit TxIDs, and handles conflict retry and replication failure
Main RPC execution, forwarding, session-consistency check, commit/retry loop, and error cleanup preventing false TxIDs
